Rashi on Nazir 21a:10:1.hebrew: לעולם אימא לך בקמא מיתפסין והאי אחרון דקאמר היינו אמצעי - וקאמר לך, דאפי' של אחרון לא הותר, משום דבקמא מיתפסין. והאי דקאמרי ליה אחרון לאו דוקא, אלא איידי דתנא ראשון, תנא אחרון:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:10:1.english: Actually, I could say to you that they associate with the first, and this "last" that it stated means the middle [one] - And [the Mishnah] is telling you that even [the vow] of the last [one] was not dissolved, because they associate with the first. And this [term] that they call him "last" is not precise; rather, since [the Tanna] taught "first," he taught "last".

Rashi on Nazir 21a:11:1.hebrew: ת"ש דתניא בהדיא כו' הותר האמצעי הימנו ולמטה מותר - דהיינו אחרון. וש"מ דכל חד וחד בחבריה מתפיס — ש"מ:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:11:1.english: Come and hear, as it is taught explicitly, etc.: If the middle one is dissolved, from him and downward is dissolved - That is, the last [one]. And learn from this that each and every one associates with his fellow — learn from this.

Rashi on Nazir 21a:12:1.hebrew: משום דקאמר פי כפיו - דמשמע דקאמר: ״פי נזיר ושערי נזיר״ — מי הוי נזיר:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:12:1.english: Just because he said: “My mouth is like his mouth” - For [this] implies that he said: “My mouth is a nazirite, and my hair is a nazirite” — does he become a nazirite?

Rashi on Nazir 21a:1:1.english: This is also taught [in a baraita] - That we require that they attach [themselves] within the time required for speaking.

Rashi on Nazir 21a:1:2.hebrew: הוא אסור - הראשון שאמר הריני נזיר, והשני שאמר ואני — מותר, לפי ששהה כדי דבור. הא אם לא שהה — הרי זה נזיר כמותו:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:1:2.english: He is bound - [This refers to] the first [person], who said, “I am hereby a nazirite”; and the second [person], who said, “And I,” is permitted, because he waited the time required for speaking. But had he not waited, he would be a nazirite like him.

Rashi on Nazir 21a:2:1.hebrew: לימא מסייע ליה מי שאמר הריני נזיר ושמע חבירו ואמר ואני ואני - ומדלא קתני אלא הנך תרין, ש"מ דמשום דאי קתני טפי לא הוי כדי דבור של ראשון, ואנן בעינן דליהוי תוך כדי דבור, ותו לא:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:2:1.english: Shall we say that [the mishna] supports him: One who said, “I am hereby a nazirite,” and his fellow heard and said, “And I,” “And I” - And since it taught only these two, learn from it that [this is] because if it had taught more, it would not be [within] the time required for the speech of the first [person], and we require that it be within the time required for speech, and no more.

Rashi on Nazir 21a:3:1.hebrew: מהכא לא תסייע ליה - דבדין הוא דהוה ליה למיתני עד מאה, אלא לאו אורחיה דתנא; כי רוכלא דמחזר על העיירות בפרגמטי' שלו והולך ומכריז ומונה, "יש לי מחטין וכוסות וקערות" — ה"נ ליחשיב וליזיל?! ואי לאו משום דווקא, ליתני חד ותו לא, ולשמעינן הני — (הכי נמי) לאו דווקא, הוי בתוך כדי דבור? אין, ה"נ; אלא משום דלא משכחת בה אמצעי דאיבעי ליה למיתנא, משום הכי נמי תני "ואני" "ואני":
Rashi on Nazir 21a:3:1.english: From here, do not support him - For by right he should have taught up to a hundred [cases]; but it is not the way of the Tanna [to enumerate endlessly]. Like a peddler who travels around the towns with his merchandise and goes and proclaims and counts, "I have needles, and cups, and bowls" — should he too reckon and go on?! And if [teaching two cases was] not because it is exact, let him teach [just] one and no more, and let him teach us these [cases — that they too] are not exact, [and that any vow] is [valid so long as it is] within the time required for speech! Indeed, that is so; rather, because you would not find in it a middle [person], which he needed to teach, for that reason he also taught: "And I," "and I."

Rashi on Nazir 21a:4:1.hebrew: איבעיא להו חד בחבריה מיתפיס - [ולא] כר"ל, ואפילו עד מאה מיתפסין ואזלין:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:4:1.english: A dilemma was raised before them: Does each one associate with the other - [And not] in accordance with Reish Lakish, and even up to a hundred can continue to associate.

Rashi on Nazir 21a:5:1.hebrew: ת"ש ואני ואני - מדלא קתני טפי, ש"מ דהיינו טעם — דבקמא מיתפסין:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:5:1.english: Come and hear: "And I," "and I" - Since [the Mishnah] does not teach more, learn from it that this is the reason: that they associate with the first.

Rashi on Nazir 21a:7:1.hebrew: ראשון הוא דשרי - כלומר: משום ראשון דאישתרי, אישתרו נמי כולהו; הא אם הותר אמצעי, לא יהא מותר אחרון שלמטה הימנו. וש"מ דטעמא הוי משום דבקמא מיתפסין:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:7:1.english: It is the first [whose vow] was dissolved - That is to say: Because of the first [whose vow] was dissolved, all of them are also dissolved; but if a middle [person's vow] was dissolved, the subsequent [person] below him would not be dissolved. And learn from this that the reason is that they associate [their vows] with the first.

Rashi on Nazir 21a:8:1.hebrew: לעולם אימא לך חד בחבריה מיתפיס - וכי הותר אמצעי, הותר נמי אחרון. והא דלא קתני לה — משום דלא אפשר; דאיידי דבעי למיתנא "כי הותר ראשון הותרו כולן" — משום שאם אין ראשון אין אמצעי ואין אחרון — ואי תני אמצעי, לא מצי למיתנא "הותרו כולן", דהא איכא ראשון דלא משתרי, כו':
Rashi on Nazir 21a:8:1.english: Actually, I could say to you: Each associates with the other - And when the middle [one] is released, the last [one] is also released. And that which [the Mishnah] did not teach this is because it was not possible; for since it wanted to teach, “When the first was released, all of them were released” — because if there is no first, there is no middle and there is no last — and had it taught [the case of] the middle [one], it could not have taught, “All of them were released,” for behold, there is the first who is not released, etc.:

Rashi on Nazir 21a:9:1.hebrew: מדקאמר האחרון מותר וכולן אסורים - ואפילו אותו שהתפיסו לאחר שלישי, שמע מינה דבקמא מיתפסין, ומשום הכי לא מישתרו:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:9:1.english: From the fact that it says: The last is permitted and all of them are forbidden - and [this includes] even the one who associated [his vow] after the third — learn from this that they associate with the first, and for this reason they are not released.

Rashi on Nazir 21a:9:2.hebrew: א"ל מהכא ליכא למשמע מידי - דהכא מיירי דליכא אחרינא בהדיה, והא דקאמר ״וכולן אסורים״ — אאמצעי ואראשון קאי:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:9:2.english: He said to him: Nothing can be inferred from here - For here [the Mishnah] is dealing with [a case] where there is no other [person] with him; and that which it states, “and they are all forbidden,” refers to the middle one and the first one.

Rashi on Nazir 21a:9:3.hebrew: אבל אמצעי דאיכא אחרינא בהדיה - כלומר, דאי לא דייקת מינה להאי גיסא, דוק מינה לאידך גיסא: דמדקאמר "האחרון מותר וכולן אסורין" — דליכא אחרינא בהדיה, מכלל דאי הותר אמצעי, דאית ליה אחריני בהדיה, דאישתרי נמי ההוא בתרא דמיתפיס ביה; וש"מ דחד בחבריה מתפיס:
Rashi on Nazir 21a:9:3.english: However, a middle one, where there is someone else with him - That is to say, if you do not deduce from it in this direction, deduce from it in the other direction: for since it says, “The last is dissolved and they are all bound,” [because] there is no one else with him, it follows that if a middle one was dissolved, who has others with him, that subsequent one who associated [his vow] with him is also dissolved; and learn from this that each one associates [his vow] with the other.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:11:1.hebrew: תא שמע דתניא בהדיא וכו' - "הותר אמצעי, הימנו ולמטה מותר" — אלמא חד בחבריה מיתפיס:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:11:1.english: "Come and hear, as it is taught explicitly, etc." - "If the middle one was dissolved, from him and downward is dissolved" — it follows that each [person] associates [his vow] with his fellow.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:1:1.hebrew: תניא נמי הכי - פירוש: כרבי שמעון בן לקיש:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:1:1.english: "This is also taught [in a baraita]" - Explanation: In accordance with Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:1:2.hebrew: מי שאמר הריני נזיר ושמע חבירו ושהה כדי דבור - פי': כדי דבור דווקא ולא יותר, ואומר מיד "ואני" — "הוא אסור", פירוש: הראשון שנדר בנזיר, "וחבירו מותר". אלמא דלא מצי לאיתפוסי אלא שהן כולם תוך כדי דבור, אבל הרביעי ששהה אחר כדי דבור — לא, כר"ל:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:1:2.english: "One who said: 'I am hereby a nazirite,' and his fellow heard and waited the time required for speech" - Explanation: [This means that he waited] precisely the time required for speech and no more, and immediately says "And I" — [even so,] "he is bound," meaning the first [person] who vowed to be a nazirite, "and his fellow is permitted." Consequently, [this proves] that they can associate [with the vow] only when they are all within the time required for speech; but the fourth [person], who waited [until] after the time required for speech, cannot [associate] — in accordance with Reish Lakish.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:2:1.hebrew: לימא מסייע ליה מי שאמר הריני נזיר - מתניתין היא וכו', וקתני "ואני" ותו לא — לרבי יהודה נשיאה מצי למיתני "ואני", "ואני" ארבע פעמים! וא"ת: ולרשב"ל נמי ניתני "ואני", "ואני" שלש פעמים? וי"ל, דהכי קאמר: בשלמא לרשב"ל, [לא] איצטריכא ליה למתני אלא ב' פעמים "ואני", לאשמועינן דגם השני נתפס בראשון, שהוא תוך כדי דבור, ואע"ג דאמצעי מפסיק בדבורו בין ראשון לשלישי; והוא הדין דגם לשלישי שיאמר "ואני", יתפיס בראשון, דאין שום סברא לחלק בין שני לשלישי, ששניהם עומדים תוך כדי דבור. אבל לר' יהודה נשיאה, אי איתא דרביעי נמי נתפס בראשון — ליתני, דהא ודאי חדוש הוא, ואיצטריכא לי' לאשמועינן, אע"ג דשהו כבר תוך כדי דבור, כיון שהוא סמוך לאלתר לכדי דבור! ומשני: "אטו תנא כי רוכלא כו'" — כלומר: אה"נ דהוי מצי לאיתנויי ארבע פעמים "ואני", ולא חש למנות כל מה שהיה יכול למנות:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:2:1.english: Shall we say that [the Mishnah] supports him: "One who said: I am hereby a nazirite" - This is a Mishnah, etc., and it teaches: "And I," and no more — [whereas] according to Rabbi Yehuda Nesi'ah, [the tanna] could have taught "And I, and I" four times! And if you say: But according to Reish Lakish as well, let him teach "And I, and I" three times? One can say that this is what [the Gemara] means: Granted, according to Reish Lakish, it was [not] necessary for him to teach "And I" more than two times, [which was done] to teach us that the second [respondent] is also attached to the first, as it is within the time required for speech, even though the middle person interrupts with his speech between the first and the third [person]; and the same applies to a third [respondent] who would say "And I," that he would attach to the first, for there is no reason to differentiate between the second and the third [respondent], as both of them stand within the time required for speech. But according to Rabbi Yehuda Nesi'ah, if it is so that a fourth [respondent] also attaches to the first, let [the tanna] teach [it], for that is certainly a novelty and it was necessary to teach it to us: that even though the time required for speech has already elapsed, [he is still attached] because it is immediately adjacent to the time required for speech! And [the Gemara] answers: "Should the tanna continue reckoning like a peddler, etc.?" — that is to say: Indeed, it is so, that he could have taught "And I" four times, but he was not concerned with enumerating everything that he could have enumerated.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:3:1.hebrew: ומשני אה"נ ומשום דקתני סיפא וכו' מכלל דאיכא אמצעי משום הכי קתני ואני ואני - וא"ת: דהיא גופא תיקשי, דליתני חד "ואני", וסיפא ליתני: "הותר הראשון — הותר השני; הותר השני — לא הותר הראשון"? וי"ל: דלמ"ד לקמן "חד בחבריה מתפיס", נקט למידק מיניה: אחרון הוא דליכא אחריני בתריה, אבל אמצעי דאיכא אחריני בתריה — ומישתרי אותו שאחריו, כדדייק לקמן. ולמ"ד דבקמא מיתפסו, ותני אמצעי למידק כבסמוך: ראשון הוא דשרי של אחריו, הא אמצעי — לא הותר של אחריו, דבקמא מתפיס:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:3:1.english: And [the Gemara] answers: Indeed, and because [the tanna] teaches in the latter clause, etc., by inference that there is a middle [person], due to that reason it teaches: "And I," "And I" - And if you should say that this itself should be difficult: Let [the tanna] teach [just] one "And I," and in the latter clause let him teach: "If the first was released, the second is released; if the second was released, the first is not released"? And it can be said that according to the one who says later that each associates [his vow] with his fellow, [the tanna] formulated [the ruling of the last one] in order to infer from it: It is specifically the last [person], who is not followed by anyone else [whose release leaves all others bound]; but as for a middle [person], who is followed by someone else, the one after him is released, as [the Gemara] infers later. And according to the one who says that they associate [their vows] with the first, [the tanna] taught [the case of] a middle [person] in order to infer as [deduced] nearby: It is specifically the first [person whose release] releases [the vow of] the one after him, whereas [if] a middle [person was released], the one after him is not released, because he associates [his vow directly] with the first.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:4:1.hebrew: חד בחבריה מתפיס - דהיינו: כל אחד בסמוך לו, ובתוך כדי דבור לחבירו; או דלמא בקמא שאמר "הריני נזיר" מיתפסו כולם:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:4:1.english: One associates with his fellow - That is, each one [associates with the one] adjacent to him and within the time required for speech of his fellow; or perhaps they all associate with the first [one], who said "Behold, I am a nazirite."

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:4:2.hebrew: מיתפסו ואזלו לעולם - ואפי' מאה. ואי בקמא מיתפיס — טפי מכדי דבור לא היה מיתפיס: לרשב"ל כדאית ליה; ולרבי יהודה נשיאה — אפי' ד', כיון דבסמוך לכדי דבור לאלתר:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:4:2.english: "They can continue to associate forever" - And even a hundred [people]. But if [each person] associates with the first [person], [one] could not associate beyond the time required for speech: according to Reish Lakish, as he holds [that only three may associate]; and according to Rabbi Yehudah Nesia, even four [could associate], since [speaking] immediately adjacent to the time required for speech is [considered] immediate.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:5:1.hebrew: ת"ש מי שאמר הריני נזיר וכו' - דאי ס"ד חד בחבריה מיתפיס, ליתני ״ואני״ ״ואני״ טובא:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:5:1.english: "Come and hear: One who said: 'I am hereby a nazirite...'" - For if it should enter your mind that each one associates with his fellow, let [the Mishnah] teach "And I," "and I," many times.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:6:1.hebrew: מכלל דאיכא אמצעי מש"ה קתני ואני ואני - ולדקדק [דאיכא] אמצעי, כמו שדקדק והולך לשתי פנים מתניתין:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:6:1.english: "By inference that there is a middle [person], due to that reason [the Mishnah] teaches: 'And I,' 'and I'" - And [the Mishnah taught this] in order to make inferences [regarding when there is] a middle [person], just as [the Gemara] proceeds to deduce [from] the Mishnah in two ways.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:7:1.hebrew: ראשון הוא דשרו - אותם שאחריו (יד נזירה) מתפיס, מדלא קתני: "הותר אמצעי, הותר אחרון":
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:7:1.english: "It is the first one that was dissolved" - [The Gemara infers that the middle one does not release] those who are after him [who] link [to him] (Yad Nezirah), from the fact that [the Mishnah] does not teach: "If the middle one was dissolved, the last one was dissolved."

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:9:1.hebrew: אחרון הוא דליכא אחריני בתריה - הלכך, כשהותר הוא, כולן אסורין; אבל לאמצעי, דאיכא אחריני בתריה, לא מצי למיתני "הותר הוא, כולן אסורים", דשל אחרון נמי הותר:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:9:1.english: It is [only] the last one, as there is no other after him - Therefore, when he was dissolved, they are all bound; but regarding a middle one, where there is another after him, [the Mishnah] could not teach, "If he was dissolved, they are all bound," because [the vow of] the last one is also dissolved.

Tosafot on Nazir 21a:9:2.hebrew: ש"מ חד בחבריה מיתפיס - מדלא תנא: "הותר האמצעי — הוא מותר וכולן אסורין". ומשני: דאחרון היינו אמצעי, ואיידי דתנא "ראשון" תנא לישנא ד"אחרון"; והא נמי — דהוא אחרון לראשון:
Tosafot on Nazir 21a:9:2.english: "Learn from this that each associates himself with the other" - From [the fact] that [the Mishnah] did not teach: "If the middle one was dissolved, he is permitted and they are all forbidden." And [the Gemara] answers that "last" means the middle one; and since it taught "first," it used the phrasing of "last"; and this too [is fitting], because he is last relative to the first.
